title: Practice 2: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Do you like music from the 70's?
exercises.why: **нравиться → нравится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm unrolling the bundle.
exercises.why: **разворачивать → разворачиваю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: What's he on about?
exercises.why: **разглагольствовать → разглагольствует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Can you unjam the printer?
exercises.why: **мочь → можешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: A sledgehammer breaks glass but forges steel.
exercises.why: **разбивать → разбивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We inherit our genes from our parents.
exercises.why: **наследовать → наследуем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He laughs when he's tickled.
exercises.why: **смеяться → смеётся** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Ellipses have so much to hide....
exercises.why: **скрывать → скрывают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm not buying it, Tom.
exercises.why: **купиться → куплюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: The goods arrive by sea.
exercises.why: **доставляться → доставляются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We're expanding our Berlin branch.
exercises.why: **расширять → расширяем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The children are flying kites.
exercises.why: **запускать → запускают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Святых всегда ___ (изображать) с нимбом вокруг головы.
exercises.prompt: Saints are always depicted with a halo over their heads.
exercises.why: **изображать → изображают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is trying to get a green card.
exercises.why: **пытаться → пытается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She knows how to make up.
exercises.why: **знать → знает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Do you wish to make any other transaction?
exercises.why: **желать → Желаете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We have something else in common.
exercises.why: **объединять → объединяет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том ___ (набиваться) в любимчики к новому боссу.
exercises.prompt: Tom is ingratiating himself with our new boss.
exercises.why: **набиваться → набивается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: That river floods every year.
exercises.why: **разливаться → разливается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Long live the Belarus!
exercises.why: **здравствовать → здравствует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
